tasks.title: Persistent todo store over .todos.json, with tests in a temp dir
tasks.description: Create src/todo/store.js as the only module that reads or writes `.todos.json`. It takes the containing directory as an explicit argument so tests can point it at a temp directory instead of the real project root. Store shape and read semantics are pinned in contract `store-json-shape`.

context.reason: confirms "type": "module", so new src files must use ESM import/export, and confirms the node --test script
existing node:test style to mirror (node:test + node:assert/strict, no framework)

edits.change: ESM module (this package is "type": "module"). Import `readFileSync`, `writeFileSync` from 'node:fs' and `join` from 'node:path'. Export exactly: `filePath(dir)` -> `join(dir, '.todos.json')`; `readTodos(dir)` -> JSON.parse(readFileSync(filePath(dir), 'utf8')) wrapped in try/catch that returns `[]` for ENOENT and for a file whose trimmed content is empty (re-throw anything else, e.g. a SyntaxError from corrupt JSON); `nextId(todos)` -> `todos.reduce((max, t) => Math.max(max, t.id), 0) + 1`; `addTodo(dir, text)` -> read, push `{ id: nextId(todos), text: text.trim(), done: false }`, write `JSON.stringify(todos, null, 2) + '\n'` to filePath(dir), return the pushed object; `doneTodo(dir, id)` -> read, find `t => t.id === Number(id)`, set `t.done = true`, write, return the updated todo, and return `null` without writing when no todo has that id; `removeTodo(dir, id)` -> read, filter out the todo whose `id === Number(id)`, write the filtered array, return `true` when one was removed and `false` when none matched. All functions take the directory as their first argument; none of them resolve a path themselves.

node:test file using `import { test } from 'node:test'`, `import assert from 'node:assert/strict'`, `import { mkdtempSync, rmSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'`, `import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'`, `import { join } from 'node:path'` and `import { filePath, readTodos, addTodo, doneTodo, removeTodo, nextId } from '../src/todo/store.js'`. Add a `setup(t)` helper that calls `mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'todo-store-'))` and registers `t.after(() => rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }))`, and always pass that temp dir to the store functions so the real project-root `.todos.json` is never touched. Cover: `readTodos` on a directory with no `.todos.json` returns `[]`; `addTodo(dir, 'buy milk')` returns `{ id: 1, text: 'buy milk', done: false }` and the raw file content equals `JSON.stringify([{ id: 1, text: 'buy milk', done: false }], null, 2) + '\n'`; a second `addTodo` gets id 2 and `nextId(readTodos(dir))` is 3; `doneTodo(dir, 1)` marks the todo done and persists it to disk, and returns `null` for an unknown id; `removeTodo(dir, 2)` drops it from disk and returns `false` for an unknown id; `filePath(dir)` ends with `.todos.json`.

tasks.title: CLI runner (add/list/done/remove + --pending) and bin entry point, with tests in a temp dir
tasks.description: Create src/todo/cli.js exporting a side-effect-free `run(args, io)` so it can be driven from tests with a fake io and a temp cwd, and create bin/todo.js as the thin real entry point. The signature, exit codes and output contract are pinned in contract `cli-io-contract`.

edits.change: ESM module importing `{ addTodo, doneTodo, removeTodo, readTodos }` from './store.js'. Export exactly one function `export function run(args, io)`. `args` is the argv array after the node binary and script; `io` is `{ cwd, stdout, stderr }`. Define `const USAGE = ['Usage:', '  todo add <text>', '  todo list [--pending]', '  todo done <id>', '  todo remove <id>'].join('\n')`. Switch on `args[0]`: (a) `'add'` — join `args.slice(1)` with a single space; if that is empty, write USAGE to io.stderr and return 1; otherwise `const t = addTodo(io.cwd, text)`, write `Added #${t.id} ${t.text}` to io.stdout, return 0. (b) `'list'` — `const pendingOnly = args.includes('--pending')`, `const visible = readTodos(io.cwd).filter(t => !pendingOnly || !t.done)`; when `visible` is empty write `No todos.` to io.stdout and return 0, otherwise write one line per todo of the form `` `${t.done ? '✓' : ' '} [${t.id}] ${t.text}` `` (check mark character U+2713 for done, a single space otherwise) and return 0. (c) `'done'` — `const id = Number(args[1])`; if `args[1]` is missing or `Number.isNaN(id)`, write USAGE to io.stderr and return 1; `const t = doneTodo(io.cwd, id)`; if `t` is null write `No todo with id ${id}` to io.stderr and return 1, else write `Done #${t.id} ${t.text}` to io.stdout and return 0. (d) `'remove'` — same id validation as done; a `removeTodo(io.cwd, id)` returning false means write `No todo with id ${id}` to io.stderr and return 1, otherwise write `Removed #${id}` to io.stdout and return 0. (e) default (no command or an unrecognised one) — write USAGE to io.stderr and return 1. Wrap the whole switch in try/catch: on error write `Error: ${err.message}` to io.stderr and return 2. Do not reference `process` or `console` anywhere in this file.

node:test file using `import { test } from 'node:test'`, `import assert from 'node:assert/strict'`, `import { mkdtempSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs'`, `import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'`, `import { join } from 'node:path'`, `{ run }` from '../src/todo/cli.js' and `{ readTodos }` from '../src/todo/store.js'. Add a `setup(t)` helper returning `{ dir, call }` where `dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'todo-cli-'))` with `t.after(() => rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }))`, and `call(...argv)` collects stdout/stderr into arrays and returns `{ code, out, err }` with `out = out.join('\n')` and `err = err.join('\n')` — always passing `cwd: dir` so the real project-root `.todos.json` is never touched. Cover: `call('add', 'buy milk')` returns code 0, prints `Added #1 buy milk`, and leaves `readTodos(dir)` equal to `[{ id: 1, text: 'buy milk', done: false }]`; `call('list')` after one add has `out` equal to `  [1] buy milk` (two leading spaces: the not-done marker is a single space followed by ` [1]`); after `call('done', '1')`, `call('list').out` starts with `✓` and contains `[1] buy milk`, while `call('list', '--pending').out` is exactly `No todos.`; `call('remove', '1')` returns code 0 and a following `call('list').out` is `No todos.`; `call('done', '99')` and `call('remove', '99')` both return code 1 with `No todo with id 99` on stderr and do not throw; `call('nope')` and `call()` (no args) return code 1 and print `Usage:` on stderr; `call('add')` with no text returns code 1 and prints `Usage:` on stderr.

ESM entry point with a shebang `#!/usr/bin/env node` on line 1. Import `{ run }` from '../src/todo/cli.js'. Call `const code = run(process.argv.slice(2), { cwd: process.cwd(), stdout: (t) => process.stdout.write(t + '\n'), stderr: (t) => process.stderr.write(t + '\n') })` and then `process.exit(code)`. Add no other logic.

contracts.statement: `.todos.json` is a JSON array of objects where each object has exactly the keys `id` (integer, starting at 1, never reused within a file), `text` (the string given on the command line, trimmed) and `done` (boolean, false when created). A missing `.todos.json` file, an empty file, or a file containing only whitespace is read as an empty array `[]`; any other unparseable JSON is a hard error. `src/todo/store.js` is the ONLY module allowed to touch the filesystem: it exports `filePath(dir)`, `readTodos(dir)`, `addTodo(dir, text)`, `doneTodo(dir, id)`, `removeTodo(dir, id)` and `nextId(todos)`, all of which take the directory as their first argument and never resolve a path themselves.

`src/todo/cli.js` exports exactly one function, `run(args, io)`. `args` is an argv array with the subcommand at index 0 and its options/values after it. `io` is `{ cwd: string, stdout: (text: string) => void, stderr: (text: string) => void }` where `cwd` is the directory that holds `.todos.json`. `run` must write ALL output through `io.stdout` / `io.stderr` (never `console`, never `process.stdout.write` directly) and must return an integer process exit code: 0 on success, 1 for a usage error (unknown command, missing argument, unknown id) and 2 for an unexpected error such as unparseable `.todos.json`. `bin/todo.js` is the only module that touches `process` or `console`; it calls `run(process.argv.slice(2), { cwd: process.cwd(), stdout: t => process.stdout.write(t + '\n'), stderr: t => process.stderr.write(t + '\n') })` and then `process.exit(code)`.
